save.text: Announcement: First subscriber giveaway winner LL1973 at 4,200 — prize: signed Player's Handbook + signed cast photo. Next giveaway at 4,250 and every +50 subs thereafter. (confirmed by Matt)
No episode next week due to San Diego Comic-Con; Critical Role panel Thurs at PetCo Park 4-5; main Geek & Sundry panel 1-2. Panel will be filmed and streamed later. (confirmed by Matt/Marisha/Laura)
Matt and Marisha will be in New Zealand the week after Comic-Con (appear at Armageddon). Remaining available cast will stream other games during their absence. (confirmed by Matt/Marisha)
Intro video malfunctioned; cast improvised and proceeded to start the episode live. (observed by multiple; turn 75–111)

Episode recap given by Matt: Vox Machina extracted Horn of Orcus from Underdark, it's indestructible; Council decided to seal it in Platinum Sanctuary in Vasselheim on Othanzia; traveling by skyship across Ozmit Sea; attacked by wyvern/griffin bandits, party survived and has captive; currently mid-journey ~6–7 days. (turns 130–139,144–146)
Sam joined late and requested recap; confirmed the party is airborne on the skyship. (turns 132–138,145–146)
Halfling captive is a mage; was bound/locked in ship's anti-magic brig by Captain Damon due to prior attack on crew. (confirmed by Matt)
Party continued traveling over Ozmit Sea for several days, rested and regained spells; currently mid-journey toward Vasselheim/Platinum Sanctuary. (confirmed by Matt)
Grog attempted magical beard growth; produced translucent peach-fuzz; companions braided and decorated it; Beaute/physical jokes exchanged. (observed)
Party mid-sixth day travel: sky grows cloudy/grayer, colder weather toward northern continent; nature check (Keyleth) 20 indicates natural cold front (confirmed by Matt/Marisha).
Grog's goatee: glorious dark brown braided goatee ~3–4 inches, one strand different color/white translucent; Grog proud, jokes/singing exchanged. (observed)
Tiberius (Orion) trades persuasion: convinced Scanlan (Sam) to trade his circlet for Tiberius' Ioun Stone; trade accepted and exchanged (confirmed in dialogue).
Ioun Stone orbits Orion's head after trade; confirmed by Matt and Orion. (turns 323–335)
Weather: sky chillier; specks of snow begin falling ahead—party approaching colder front. (confirmed by Matt)
Keyleth (Marisha) mentions Fire Ashari in Vasselheim area (town of Pyrah); part of her Aramente she must visit headmasters; last Aramente participant didn't return. (confirmed by Marisha)
Keyleth's mother left when Keyleth was ~5–6 years old; Keyleth doesn't know if she's alive. Party plans to visit Keyleth's tribe/Aramente area when in region. (confirmed by Marisha)

Land sighted: continent Othanzia with Vesper Timberland (vast forest) and a singular mountain spire ~20–30 miles from shore with a heavily fortified city built into it; city larger than Emon with layered walls and dragon-headed ballistae defenses. (confirmed by Matt)
Kima on deck noted it had been some time; party approaching cold, snowy forest and tundra to north—Trinket appeared chilly. (observed/confirmed by Matt)
Ship docks at Vasselheim; city shows many battle-scarred buildings with repeatedly repaired walls; landing area is a flattened mill-top platform not designed for frequent skyship use. (observed)
Kima anxious about arrival; offers to answer city questions and mentions escorts will guide them. (observed)
Scanlan stores a 3rd-level Lightning Bolt spell into Ioun Stone; stone is white but glows greenish-blue. (confirmed by Matt/Scanlan)
Kima last met her Order 'properly' eight years ago; she appears nervous about meeting them now. (confirmed by Kima/Matt)
Scalebearer Yonn is an elderly, dedicated (not deceptive) member of the Order; he and Kima recognize each other. (confirmed by Matt, insight checks turns 596–600)

Platinum Sanctuary is ~25-minute walk from landing platform; escort intends to bring the party there and keep the Horn's presence limited—only Yonn, the travelers, and Highbearer Vord knew about the Horn so far. (confirmed by Yonn/Matt)

Party steps off landing platform into Vasselheim; Scalebearer Yonn leads them through city streets to the Platinum Sanctuary. City described as 'cradle of faith' with visible holy symbols (Arathis, Avandra, Melora, Bahamut) but no Sarenrae. (confirmed by Matt)

Party plans a tactical approach: some (Vex, Vax) rooftop overwatch; Keyleth can take eagle form for aerial support; Percy and Grog/Scanlan plan to stay on path/rear. Stealth checks: Scanlan 23 (succeeds), Vex rolled a 1 (failed). (players' intent/rolls)

Vasselheim streets muddy with sleet/soon snow; populace rugged, clothed in furs and leathers; city atmosphere noticed as grim and battle-scarred. Party entered muddy main street after descending staircase. (observed by Matt)
Vasselheim described as oldest known bastion of civilization; holiest place with oldest temples to major deities; arcane frowned upon publicly. (confirmed by Matt)
Platinum box (Horn's container) is ~1.5–2 ft square, solid platinum/silver with sapphire inlays; noticed but not heavily gawped at. (confirmed by Matt)

Approach to Platinum Sanctuary: long worn stone staircase (~15–20 min ascent); temple built into mountain with Draconic inscriptions (words like 'honor, justice'); Bahamut symbol on massive doors that open as Scalebearers approach. (observed by party/Matt)
Vasselheim militia called 'Bastions' are volunteer civilian militia; roughly a quarter of populace are Bastions; they patrol stairways and man ballista. (confirmed by Matt)
Temple doors close behind party on entry; Keyleth flew out but re-entered through an arrow-slit, encountered a spear-bearing guard who challenged her. (observed in-play/Matt)
Forest near city shows large, fast-moving serpentine/multi-bodied creature sighting ~¼ mile out; ballista fired; similar occurrences implied common. (observed/Matt)
Keyleth (Pike?) was briefly arrested with shackles by temple guards; Kima identified her as 'with me' and had cuffs removed; Scalebearer Yonn embarrassed. (confirmed by Matt/Kima)

Temple interior described as plain, ancient stone fortress humming with strong divine energy—Pike senses unusual holiness (temple 'goes to six'). Kima warns against fraternizing in temple. (observed by Matt/Kima/Pike)
Scalebearers removed cuffs after Kima vouched; party led through main chamber toward Sanctuary. (confirmed by Matt)

Platinum Sanctuary central chamber: ~80-ft domed ceiling with ancient creation mural depicting elemental planes, Astral, Hells, Abyss, Prime, and Bahamut fighting a five-headed chromatic dragon (Tiamat). (observed by party/Matt)

Highbearer Vord introduced: slender old elven male in white robes, Bahamut emblem necklace; recognizes Kima. Declares the group carries a Horn of Orcus; container pulses then vanishes when holy symbol used. (observed/confirmed by Matt)
Scalebearers presented container; instructed not to open. Vord confirms artifact is genuine Horn of Orcus and insists it must be sealed. (confirmed by Vord via Matt)

Hall of Exalt beneath temple houses vault chamber; Star of Exaltation (divine relic tied to Bahamut) destroyed ~300 years ago during a siege; chamber has been used in ritual requiring Bahamut’s intervention. (confirmed by Matt)

Lower chambers infested with subterranean spider creatures; Scalebearer tasked with preparing vault triggered some defenses and fled (Yonn). Party asked to clear beasts and escort reliquary into vault. (confirmed by Matt; Yonn reaction observed)
Temple security: continuous divine/watchful protection; some automated defenses active and will alert if full vault triggered; Scalebearers will accompany party and carry the box. (confirmed by Matt)
No dragons detected within six-mile radius of Vasselheim per Keyleth's Primeval Awareness. (confirmed by Matt, turn 1052)
Temple offers party 3,000 gp total to deliver/seal the artifact (Kima/Highbearer stated). Kima escorts party to vault. (confirmed by Matt, turns 1093–1104, 1130–1132)

Approach to Platinum Sanctuary: long worn stone staircase (~15–20 min ascent); temple built into mountain with Draconic inscriptions (words like 'honor, justice'); Bahamut symbol on massive doors that open as Scalebearers approach. (observed by party/Matt)

New chamber beneath Platinum Sanctuary: 50x50 ft, ~20 ft high; thick white mist emitted from mouths of two dragon-carved pillars ~20 ft apart; mist refills quickly after Gust of Wind. (observed by party/Matt)
Pillars' bases are slightly raised/not flush with floor—appear to pivot/rotate (noticed by Vax, Perception 19). (turn):1141
Kima used hidden recess with her holy symbol to dispel wood illusion, revealing stone doorway and staircase into vault area; she hasn't been inside vault before (Kima/Matt).
During transfer of earrings ~30–40s, clear central pathway existed; party ran through while maintaining concentration on a spell. (observed by Matt).
Shoulder breaking edge of mist barrier triggered dragon-mouth pillars: they burst into fiery spinning flames; instant reaction affects those in center. (confirmed by Matt).
Dexterity saves: Vax and Tiberius each took 12 fire damage (successful/Uncanny Dodge adjusted); Scanlan, Keyleth, and Pike each took 24 fire damage. (rolls and results announced by Matt).

Circular room with many floor circles/pistoning pillars: stepping on a circle triggered room rotation and pillars pistoning into ceiling; pillars can slam, catch ankles/shoulders and do heavy crushing damage (Vax took 40). (observed/confirmed by Matt; Vax actions/rolls).

Vax used Boots of Haste to sprint through room, made acrobatics (22), then used Luck nat20 to save an initial Dex save; later acrobatics 18 and Dex 15 resulted in being slammed and taking 40 crushing damage; final acrobatics 23 to recover. (Vax/Liam rolls confirmed by Matt).
The room opens to a wide 20-foot staircase opposite; room is cylindrical, no light until Vex's illuminated arrow revealed layout. (observed by Matt; Vex arrow and perception checks).
Room is a rotating grinding mill with pistoning pillars that slam into ceiling; pillars can bruise/crush (Vax suffered broken ribs and heavy crushing damage). (Matt, turn 1399–1401,1386–1387)
Vax made Acrobatics 23 to dodge and escape across the room despite severe pain; earlier acro/Dex rolls led to being slammed and taking 40 crushing damage (Liam/Matt). (confirmed)
Perception (25) revealed a small coin-sized hole in the ceiling at center, visible only when a pillar retracts; hole aligns with where a pillar slams into roof. (multiple PCs, Matt, turn 1399–1406)
Vex's arrow ricocheted into ceiling hole; arcane force shoved it through, causing splintering and grinding metal to pour from hole; pillars scraped/grinding stopped. (Matt, turns 1481–1490)
Vax clutching broken rib after crossing room; party begins short rest and will heal using hit dice (Vax and Sam indicated). (turns 1505,1513–1516)
Stream break/charity segment begins; guests Orion and Taylor introduced; GameChanger charity mentioned; Taylor shares personal cancer-recovery story. (turns 1523–1553)

Donations segment: Tonight's donations will go to GameChanger; 826LA's portion redirected to GameChanger for tonight; GameChanger/Deus Ex promo: donate >$1 gets game. (Taylor/Orion/Zac/Matt, turns 1556–1611)
Site crash reported during donation drive; donation link (826LA page) still working and used to route donations to GameChanger. (Zac/Matt, turns 1607–1611)
